title: One true God
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s true Bible story you will hear about people having to CHOOSE which God they will follow

Elijah tells the people that they will build 2 altars
BUT NOT TO LIGHT IT
That their God will light it with fire

The people worshipping Baal call out all day, but NOTHING happens

Elijah then builds his using 12 stones, representing the 12 tribes of Israel
AND he even puts water over it - making it hard to light
(wet things cant burn)
BUT ELIJAH’s GOD, our GOD IS SO POWERFUL - IT LIGHTS EVEN THOUGH IT IS WET!!!!
